messages.en:
{07 15 00}You DO know you have to
dig fossils up as soon
as you find them, right?
{07 0b 00}If you wait until the next
day, they won't be there,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}I think I'll start calling
fossil hunting{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.the
mysterious journey.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Sa ju TEAD, et fossiilid
tuleb üles kaevata kohe,
kui need leiad, eks?
{07 0b 00}Kui ootad järgmise
päevani, pole neid enam,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Hakkan vist fossiilijahti
kutsuma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.salapäraseks
teekonnaks.

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}You can sell your fossils

prices{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}I wonder if it's because you
